description: This file defines interfaces, functions, and classes related to statistical analysis of image channels, including computation of mean, variance, covariance, and SSIM for image quality assessment.

classes.name: FastStats
classes.description: A class implementing the Stats interface, providing efficient computation of statistical measures over image channels using partial sums.

methods.name: ssim
methods.description: Calculates the Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) between two regions of images based on provided statistics.
